findings: CandidateValidation wraps only HelperSupervisor.run through validate_with_execution; before/after candidate and executable snapshots run outside the same I/O lease.
Worker source/output keys are reserved atomically before domain-slot and CPU admission. The helper takes the same I/O-before-CPU order; no reviewed path holds CPU while awaiting this I/O gate.
with_io_file keeps a nonblocking read descriptor until the callback settles, rejects non-regular objects before accounting, and closes its own descriptor on success or exception.
DngValidation Off returns before execution admission. Candidate mutation, malformed or misbound receipts, confirmed errors and all cancellation guards retain their existing require/warn semantics.

Execution cancellation cannot become a Warning pass: cancelled cancellation overrides the verdict. The supervisor returns only after helper settlement; queued cancellation returns without spawning a child.
Per-device keys are explicitly ephemeral st_dev scheduling groups. This creates no physical-disk identity, pathname pin, mount-lifetime authority, memory cap or throughput proof.
Known descriptor estimate increases from eight to nine for the extra held execution descriptor; actual global descriptor/RSS accounting remains outside this source qualification.

The extra execution descriptor ownership flag is allocated before open; the outer allocation guard closes only while owned and clears ownership before close, preventing a later outer exception from re-closing a recycled descriptor.
limitations: This audit does not qualify actual Adobe initialization, decoding, codecs, parallel area tasks, RSS or real-corpus validation.
Existing FinalPublication/candidate snapshot fences remain essential; the filesystem gate is not an authorization or byte-equality proof.
All native processes and inputs in the independent integration suite are test-created synthetic fixtures, under /private/tmp only.

scope: Independent integration audit; no Adobe SDK or Photo operations.
